title: Catalyst Module Manifest Schema
description: JSON schema for validating module.yaml files in Catalyst framework modules.

description.description: Concise summary of module domain and capabilities.

grounding_type.description: Primary grounding artifact type (e.g. rule, policy).

schema.description: Path to ETD schema file relative to module root.

name.description: Slash command name without leading slash; its text is the module's CODE-OF-CONDUCT §4 entry.

spec_path.description: Deprecated (0.49.0, unused): agents get the command from the composed CODE-OF-CONDUCT §4.
Path to skill definition SKILL.md file relative to module root.

entity_type.description: Entity type prefix matching an entity_types entry.

template_path.description: Path to markdown template relative to module root.

definitions.description: Versioned prose definitions the module contributes (MODULE-SPECIFICATION §6.3).

entity_type.description: Entity type prefix, or another module concept the definition covers.

path.description: Path to DEFINITION-<TYPE>-vN.md relative to module root.

rules_of_rules.description: Module meta-rules appended to the deployed Rules-of-Rules.md (§6.1).

code_of_conduct.description: Module document types and commands inserted into CODE-OF-CONDUCT §3/§4 (§6.2).

invariants.description: Module invariants read with the kernel INVARIANTS.md (§6.4).

taskfile.description: Module tasks appended to the deployed Taskfile.common.yml (§6.5).

migrations.description: Folder holding the module's migrations and migrations.md index (§6.6).

required_paths.description: Paths every deployment of this module must carry, checked by check_deployment.py.

path.description: Path relative to the working-copy root.

invariant.description: Invariant that requires it (e.g. one in the module's INVARIANTS.module.md).

seed.description: Module template used to create it when missing.
